key.who: everyone who will still be alive in 2076, starting with the young people in this room
key.broken: the debate about letting AI run the world is all opinions and headlines, and nobody can see the odds of where each choice leads
key.changed: AI Runs the Planet gives an AI and the audience the same 360-point budget, plays thousands of futures to 2076 and shows the best, most likely and scariest one on a globe
key.proof: the AI kept 92% of futures below 2 degrees but put 1 point into coastal protection, so 31 million people are pushed out by the sea in its most likely future

hook: In 2076, I'll still be here. Most of you will too.
person: Malek and everyone in the room
